findings.reason: a node that implements the sentence as a general rule adds a refusal for undeclared codex lanes, reddening the argv tests §2/§6 rest on, and §14 delegates that suite delta to the coordinator at merge rather than running it, so the regression would not be caught by the node's own gate; scoping the rule to a claude-family backend keeps the named mechanism and removes the hazard.
findings.text: §14 says "A backend that declares no image input still refuses an attached image by name, as today", unqualified, but a codex backend that declares no image input does not refuse today: `_CodexDialect.argv` emits one `-i <path>` per image regardless of any declaration, and that is exactly what `tests/test_launch_plan_attaches_images.py::test_two_figures_emit_two_flags_each_carrying_its_path` asserts against an undeclared codex fixture (`CODEX = {"launch": "cli", "command": "codex", "sandbox": "worktree-full"}`) and what §6's dispatch tests rely on

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `_refuse_images` (`reckon/_backends.py:1071`), `_ClaudeDialect.argv` (`:1594`), `launch_plan` (`:2107`), `prompt`/`stdin_text` (`:394`, `:2267`), `_backend_settings` (`reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:910`), the imports key tuple at `:976`, `test_a_lane_that_cannot_carry_the_figure_refuses_by_name` (`tests/test_launch_plan_attaches_images.py:105`) and `test_codex_declares_image_input.py` all resolve; §14 carries no hrefs.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §14's done-when names a measurable negative control (remove the image naming from `launch_plan`, the declared backend's prompt names no image and the test fails) and every clause reads against a file or a resolved config.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §14's logs are "written under the run directory, starts with its revision and the literal command, and ends in `EXIT=`", and its write paths are repository files, not a scratchpad.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan label, stage name or ticket number reaches a symbol, file or comment in §14.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §14 states an unqualified rule that contradicts the codex behaviour the plan's own §2 and §6 depend on.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — the naming mechanism and clive's declaration are one capability: a declaration without the naming makes clive refuse, and the naming without the declaration leaves clive unselected, so neither half closes alone.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §14 declares depends-on `a-review-can-see-the-figure#s13` and the plan carries `plan-informs scoring-should-stop-a-promotion`; §13 is the evidence §14 rests on and every other plan it cites (§10, §12) is already `done`, so no ordering dependency is missing.
